notes.title: Version 1.2.0 - Flags Update
notes.content:
- Added country flags to all the languages available

 - Changed the old start icon to the more modern menu icon

- Added a select icon for the languages

- Adjusted some of the UI to make it look cleaner

- Fixed an issue where the music would be the default volume for a split second before going back to the chosen volume by the player

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 - Language Update
notes.content:
-Fixed an issue where the box blended in with the background on first first time launching the game.

-Added new languages to interface:
Japanese, German, Italian, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Korean, Russian and Polish.

In case there are some errors in your language, I apologize and encourage anyone to join the discord and tell me where the errors are and what should be changed
